newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae names new industrial group.
newsitem.headline: Sonae names new industrial group.

text.p: Sonae Investimentos said on Tuesday that the new holding for its industrial and media interests will be called Inparsa.
Sonae's retail, distribution and property interests will remain within Sonae Investimentos in a reorganisation whose general outlines were announced earlier this year.
Sonae said that the plan for the reorganisation had been formally approved by a shareholders meeting.
Sonae Investimentos, which is capitalised at 40 billion escudos, will look after the group's hypermarkets, supermarkets, specialised retail outlets, property and financial services.
Inparsa-Industria & Participacoes will be capitalised at 19.5 billion escudos and takes over the group's controlling stake in Sonae Industria and media concern Pargeste.
